field.name: RequirementIds.parse result
field.type: { date: string; hash8: string; story?: number | undefined; fr: number } | undefined
field.purpose: Stored requirement ids carry only the date and the first 8 hash characters, so parse returns those parts (story and fr as numbers) instead of epicHash, ordinal and storyId.

rationale: The interface sketch in sc1 cannot be implemented from stored requirement ids: they contain no full epic hash. The existing parseFrId result is what its tests and callers rely on.
rejectedReason: Superseded: the AMD-5 amendment states the RequirementIds.parse change explicitly as superseding the old return type; this was one of four identical duplicates filed by repeated design.story runs for s1.
